name: Short Cut Steakhouse Wedge Chopped Salad with Roast Beef, Bacon, Tomatoes & Blue Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place the contents of each salad kit in a medium bowl (reserving dressing and topping packets).
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (12.35 oz) pkg steakhouse wedge chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes. Medium dice roast beef. Add both to the bowl with the salad along with the dressing and steakhouse seasoning. Toss to combine the salad, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (12 oz) pkg cherry tomatoes
1 (7 oz) pkg deli roast beef

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy onions and bacon. Enjoy!
